text:
Type: round wire storage table with lid
Use: storing throws, toys or magazines, holding drinks; living room, bedroom, kids room
Style: contemporary, Scandinavian, minimalist
Materials: white powder-coated steel wire basket, solid white lid with a finger slot
Colors: white
Shape: round drum shape, lift-off flat top with a slot handle, open triangular wire pattern on the sides, rests directly on the floor, light and see-through
Feel: airy, fresh, playful, tidy
Goes with: white walls, light wood, plants and soft textiles; Scandinavian or modern living rooms and small apartments

product.name: KVISTBRO
product.description: You can store everything from throws and pillows to newspapers and yarn in the basket - or let it stay empty to give an open, spacious feeling.
